# Pexels

Pexels offers a free API that provides access to a vast library of high-quality photos and videos, enabling seamless integration into applications and websites.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pexels/.

## Actions

- **Get Collection Media** (read-only): Get all media within a collection by its id.
- **Get Curated Photos** (read-only): Get real-time curated photos.
- **Get My Collections** (read-only): Get all of the user's collections on pexels.
- **Get Photo** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific photo.
- **Get Popular Videos** (read-only): Retrieve current popular pexels videos.
- **Search Photos** (read-only): Search for photos on pexels.
- **Search Videos** (read-only): Search for videos on pexels by query and optional filters.
- **Featured Collections**: Get featured collections.
